Its tags are 홍수, 수리학적, 예보, 조도계수, 단면. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-12-24 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read).
